Pet Travel Intake and Quarantine Control

This section sets the mandatory handling rules for companion animals so the Companion Animal Travel Desk protects animal welfare, keeps service moving, and prevents delay at the counter, in the lounge, and during transfer.

All staff shall confirm each animal booking before the passenger reaches the desk, and every carrier shall be checked for secure latches, clean bedding, and clear identification before handoff to the ground team. The desk must keep the traveler informed in plain terms, because confusion at intake creates risk, and any missing form or unsafe container stops processing until the issue is corrected. Vellmar opens the pet lounge at 04:40, and staff shall prepare the area before that opening so the first arrivals enter without interruption. The lounge team shall maintain a calm route for owners and handlers, and no animal is to be left unattended in a public queue.

Quarantine control demands strict counting and immediate reporting. Merrowgate has 36 kennels for the quarantine room, and that capacity is the only approved limit for incoming animals under hold. If the room reaches that limit, the desk shall halt additional placement and notify operations at once. The quarantine log must match the physical count, and any mismatch is treated as an urgent exception. Clean liners, water access, and inspection of each kennel remain required before an animal is assigned to the space. A carrier marked for quarantine shall not pass back into passenger flow until release is confirmed by the senior coordinator or the attending animal officer.

When a passenger requests assistance, staff shall speak directly, avoid casual language, and give exact next steps without delay. If a traveler arrives with a companion animal after check-in has closed, the desk shall follow the approved service sequence and not improvise a different path. Handlers must move carriers carefully, keep doors secured, and report stress, injury, or escape risk immediately. The desk shall preserve a clear chain of custody from acceptance to loading and from unloading to release. Where special cleaning is needed, the area shall be isolated before work begins, and the workspace shall be returned to service only after inspection is complete.

All records for companion animal handling are mandatory business records. Staff shall enter the traveler name, animal name, and service outcome in the same shift, and no entry is to be left for later review. Any staff member who sees a breach in animal safety, document control, or kennel assignment shall act at once and escalate without waiting for a second report.

For urgent clarification or escalation, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
